not be used, disclosed or reproduced in any format without prior written permission of L&T Energy-Hydrocarbon, AdVENT.

Contents
Revision Record 2
1 Scope 4
2 Reference Documents 4
3 Definitions 4
4 Notes 4
5 Indicative Inspection & Test Plan 5

1 Scope
This inspection and test plan covers the minimum testing requirements of the Desuperheater. The scope of
inspection shall be as per PO / Contractual requirements. The Sub-contractor / manufacturer / vendor / supplier
shall prepare stage wise inspection & testing plan in details complying the requirements of applicable specification,
material requisition & data sheets and shall submit for review/approval.
2 Reference Documents
Material Requisition or Purchase Requisition
Purchase Order
Code & Standards
Project Specifications & Design Philosophy.
3 Definitions
4 Notes
This is an INDICATIVE INSPECTION & TEST PLAN (IITP) only. Vendor to cover all major stages in line
with data sheet, drawings, relevant MR, statutory requirements (if any) and governing code guidelines.
Detailed INSPECTION & TEST PLAN shall be submitted for LTEH approval.
In the event of any conflict between the technical requirements of a project specification, procedure, or
drawing, the most stringent requirement shall govern.
Acceptance norms for all the activities shall be as per PO / purchase requisition / code & standards
referred therein / project specifications / approved documents.
Vendor shall carry out additional testing required, if any not specified in above, as per PO / specification.

Notes: -
1. In the event of conflict between purchase specifications, contract documents and ITP, conditions that are more stringent shall be applicable.
2. This document generally describes the requirements pertaining to all types of the item. Requirements specific to PO and the item are only applicable.
3. Acceptance norms for all the activities shall be as per PO/PR/Standards referred there in/Job specification/Approved documents.
4. Vendors shall carry out additional testing required, if any not specified above, as per PO/Technical specification.
5. Calibration status of measuring and monitoring instruments/machines to be verified by TPIA during inspection activities.
6. Spares shall be offered for inspection along with main Items - "Separate Annexure with Main IRN" or "Separate IRN" for Spares shall be obtained in line with approved
Spare list.
7. Wherever W/R Is mentioned, it is at the sole discretion of "LTEH" to Decide W or R while approval of ITP during order execution.
8. Inspection stages of Owner/PMC/Licensor would be informed during order execution/Pre-Inspection meeting.
9. For Sub-Vendor Items, the main vendor shall be involved in the inspection prior to offering to LTEH/TPIA.
10. All statutory approval / certification shall be taken by vendor wherever applicable.
11. For AS & SS Material IGC test as per ASTM Practice E to be carried out, Additionally, Microscopic structure to be observed at 250X magnification for checking no
carbide precipitation.
